title_zh: 襄阳市委书记调整，关志鸥：这是省委反复酝酿、慎重研究决定的
title_en: Xiangyang Party Secretary Adjusted; Guan Zhi'ou: Decision Made After Deliberation by Provincial Committee
summary_zh: 2026年8月23日，湖北省委宣布调整襄阳市委书记，省委常委关志鸥表示这是省委反复酝酿、慎重研究决定的。
summary_en: On August 23, 2026, Hubei Provincial Committee announced the adjustment of Xiangyang's Party Secretary, with provincial official Guan Zhi'ou stating it was made after repeated deliberation.
